speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: A penny. And two fingers short of the notch my husband cut, when a loaf was a loaf. I am not charging you twopence to console myself. Mark me, the notch does not move because the baker does.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: A penny, then. I am not asking you to restore it, and I am not asking the baker to be ashamed of me. Two fingers is the truth. Put it on the board and let it be the breakfast.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: It is the breakfast. Alse has already cut it. If you are going to sigh over a loaf, sigh after you have eaten, so the sigh is not a speech to a hungry kitchen.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I cut it on the line she showed me. The missing bit is missing. I did not eat the missing bit on the stair. I would say so if I had, because a stair is a bad place to be clever.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I believe the stair. I believe the notch. I am not opening the coffer this morning to compare a loaf with a lock.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Good. The coffer is your box. I have not been in it. Your letters are where you left them, which is where they were yesterday, which is where you put them before Richmond. I air a room. I do not inventory a man's papers.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Leave them. I am not counting today until after supper, and I am not lifting what lies at the bottom to see that it is still tied. If it is tied, it can stay tied in the dark.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: I do not know what is at the bottom, and I do not mean to learn it over bread. Gib was on the chronicle again. I moved him. Master Field's book is not a bed, and a cat is not a scholar, whatever he thinks when the house is quiet.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Thank you. The chronicle stays. I told Field it would see the new year in this house, and I meant the shelf, not the cat.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: He sits where the warm is. I put him on the Chaucer last night and he forgave me by morning, which is to say he left. I am not making a third book for him. Two is enough arguing.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Supper is at six. Tonight you are in, if the book you mean to rule is a book and not a reason to miss a meal. I have had players miss meals. It does not improve the playing, and it wastes the fire.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Six. I will be at the table. The ruling is after, by a candle, and it will not be a speech to the house. A year can be counted without an audience.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then count it upstairs. I want the sum the way I want other men's sums, which is not at all, unless it is the rent, and the rent is paid. You paid it early. I have not forgotten, and I am not hinting at a second payment to celebrate a calendar.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: No second payment. No hint taken. The latch is still mended, and I am still not paying for the mending. We agree, which is a good way to begin a last day.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Is a last day different in the eating? I only ask because the loaf is already short, and a short loaf on a last day sounds like a sign, and Mistress hates a sign before noon.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: It is not a sign. It is a baker. Eat. The pump is running. The step is swept. Nobody in this house is going out to be symbolic in a frost.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Nobody is. I have a book for after supper, and a loaf for now. The loaf is the ordinary part. I am glad of an ordinary part.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Ordinary is what I let the room for. Comedy yesterday, arithmetic tonight, and a penny this morning. I can bear a house that keeps its kinds separate. Finish the crust. The crust is the part a short loaf cannot spare.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will finish it. And I will not write the baker into the book as a villain. Two fingers, a penny, and the notch. That is the whole of the grievance, and it is not a grievance. It is a measure.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Then I will take the plate when you are done, and I will not ask what the book is for. Mistress said a question about a play is a play, and I had one yesterday. I am saving the next.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Save it. Go up when you go up. I have a jug and a morning, and both of them are mine.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I will take the crusts with the plate. A short loaf does not get a second cutting from me. One cut was the line she showed me.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: One cut is the right number. I am not opening a book to argue with a baker, and I am not opening the coffer to pay him a speech.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then we are finished with bakers. The pump is running, the step is swept, and six is still six. I will not say six a third time unless you are late.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will not be late. The book is after supper. The morning is the loaf, and the loaf is finished.
